units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|As you descend towards the surface of this seemingly uninhabited world, you activate your ship's radar system to scan the surface for anything of interest. While waiting for something to appear, you look up and catch a glimpse of a cloud of dust bursting from the ground far off to your right. Peering back down to your radar, you check the surface scans of that direction, but nothing appears. As you continue your flight, another sudden dust cloud appears several minutes later, but still nothing on the radar. You decide to keep your ship a few thousand meters above the surface and take the time to carefully look around, but there still doesn't seem to be anything of note besides the cracked rock formations and valleys of sand.|40|0
units.english: As you descend towards the surface of this seemingly uninhabited world, you activate your ship's radar system to scan the surface for anything of interest. While waiting for something to appear, you look up and catch a glimpse of a cloud of dust bursting from the ground far off to your right. Peering back down to your radar, you check the surface scans of that direction, but nothing appears. As you continue your flight, another sudden dust cloud appears several minutes later, but still nothing on the radar. You decide to keep your ship a few thousand meters above the surface and take the time to carefully look around, but there still doesn't seem to be anything of note besides the cracked rock formations and valleys of sand.
units.italian: Mentre scendi verso la superficie di questo mondo apparentemente disabitato, attivi il radar della nave per scansionare il terreno in cerca di qualcosa di interessante. Mentre aspetti che compaia qualcosa, alzi lo sguardo e intravedi una nuvola di polvere che esplode dal suolo lontano alla tua destra. Torni a guardare il radar e controlli le scansioni di quella direzione, ma non appare nulla. Mentre continui il volo, qualche minuto dopo compare un'altra nuvola di polvere, ma sul radar ancora niente. Decidi di tenere la nave qualche migliaio di metri sopra la superficie e di prenderti il tempo di guardarti bene intorno, ma oltre alle formazioni rocciose crepate e alle valli di sabbia non sembra esserci niente degno di nota.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	Suddenly, your radar system picks up a larger signal on the horizon, and you see a bulky, rock-like structure. Once you get close enough, the structure begins to resemble a ship like ones you've seen flying around in the nearby systems, although it is half sunken into the sand.|41|0
units.english: Suddenly, your radar system picks up a larger signal on the horizon, and you see a bulky, rock-like structure. Once you get close enough, the structure begins to resemble a ship like ones you've seen flying around in the nearby systems, although it is half sunken into the sand.
units.italian: Improvvisamente il radar rileva un segnale più grande all'orizzonte, e vedi una struttura massiccia, simile a una roccia. Quando ti avvicini abbastanza, la struttura comincia a somigliare a una delle navi che hai visto volare nei sistemi vicini, anche se è per metà sprofondata nella sabbia.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	(Land near the ship and investigate.)|43|0
units.english: (Land near the ship and investigate.)
units.italian: (Atterra vicino alla nave e indaga.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	(Continue to search the surface.)|44|0
units.english: (Continue to search the surface.)
units.italian: (Continua a cercare sulla superficie.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	You carefully land your ship nearby, exiting your ship in an environment suit with your sidearm on hand and walk towards the alien spacecraft. The ship appears a bit larger than you thought - around the size of a Firebird. The dark-brown hull appears to be made from an unknown material, and has several metallic-looking parts both hatched in crevices and protruding outward. Oddly enough, the warship seems perfectly intact, but the way it is angled into the sand suggests that the ship has been there for some time. There doesn't seem to be any activity around it either. You decide to head back to your ship and take another look around the area.|46|0
units.english: You carefully land your ship nearby, exiting your ship in an environment suit with your sidearm on hand and walk towards the alien spacecraft. The ship appears a bit larger than you thought - around the size of a Firebird. The dark-brown hull appears to be made from an unknown material, and has several metallic-looking parts both hatched in crevices and protruding outward. Oddly enough, the warship seems perfectly intact, but the way it is angled into the sand suggests that the ship has been there for some time. There doesn't seem to be any activity around it either. You decide to head back to your ship and take another look around the area.
units.italian: Atterri con cautela nelle vicinanze e scendi dalla nave in tuta ambientale, con l'arma da fianco pronta, e ti avvicini al vascello alieno. La nave sembra un po' più grande di quanto pensassi, all'incirca delle dimensioni di un Firebird. Lo scafo bruno scuro sembra fatto di un materiale sconosciuto e presenta diverse parti dall'aspetto metallico, incassate nelle fessure e sporgenti verso l'esterno. Stranamente la nave da guerra pare perfettamente intatta, ma il modo in cui è inclinata nella sabbia lascia pensare che sia lì da tempo. Intorno non sembra esserci attività. Decidi di tornare alla nave e dare un'altra occhiata alla zona.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	As you fly onward, an erratic signature on the surface appears on the edge of your radar. A large arch-like structure becomes visible in the distance, but disappears shortly after. You set your ship down close to the location and exit to investigate.|47|0
units.english: As you fly onward, an erratic signature on the surface appears on the edge of your radar. A large arch-like structure becomes visible in the distance, but disappears shortly after. You set your ship down close to the location and exit to investigate.
units.italian: Mentre voli, un segnale irregolare sulla superficie compare al margine del radar. In lontananza si intravede una grande struttura ad arco, che poco dopo scompare. Posi la nave vicino al punto e scendi a indagare.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	As you fly onward, an erratic signature on the surface appears on the edge of your radar. A large arch-like structure becomes visible in the distance, but disappears shortly after. You set your ship down close to the location and exit to investigate, making sure to equip an environment suit and holster your sidearm.|50|0
units.english: As you fly onward, an erratic signature on the surface appears on the edge of your radar. A large arch-like structure becomes visible in the distance, but disappears shortly after. You set your ship down close to the location and exit to investigate, making sure to equip an environment suit and holster your sidearm.
units.italian: Mentre voli, un segnale irregolare sulla superficie compare al margine del radar. In lontananza si intravede una grande struttura ad arco, che poco dopo scompare. Posi la nave vicino al punto e scendi a indagare, assicurandoti di indossare una tuta ambientale e di riporre l'arma da fianco nella fondina.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	Much to your surprise, there is a large humanoid figure standing where the signature originated from. Your radar showed something much less defined than a humanoid, but standing in front of you is a large, bulky being cladded in what looks like a form of metallic armor, wielding a spear-like weapon. The figure moves around attentively as if it is focused on its surroundings, but appears to take no interest in your presence. The encounter feels very odd in that there is no immediate interaction or acknowledgment of your existence.|52|0
units.english: Much to your surprise, there is a large humanoid figure standing where the signature originated from. Your radar showed something much less defined than a humanoid, but standing in front of you is a large, bulky being cladded in what looks like a form of metallic armor, wielding a spear-like weapon. The figure moves around attentively as if it is focused on its surroundings, but appears to take no interest in your presence. The encounter feels very odd in that there is no immediate interaction or acknowledgment of your existence.
units.italian: Con tua grande sorpresa, dove è partito il segnale c'è una grande figura umanoide. Il radar mostrava qualcosa di molto meno definito di un umanoide, ma davanti a te c'è una creatura grande e massiccia, rivestita di quella che sembra una forma di armatura metallica, con un'arma a forma di lancia. La figura si muove con attenzione, come concentrata su ciò che la circonda, ma non sembra interessata alla tua presenza. L'incontro è molto strano, perché non c'è alcuna interazione né alcun riconoscimento della tua esistenza.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	(Approach the alien.)|54|0
units.english: (Approach the alien.)
units.italian: (Avvicinati all'alieno.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	(Turn back to my ship.)|55|0
units.english: (Turn back to my ship.)
units.italian: (Torna alla mia nave.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	Suddenly, the ground starts to vibrate intensely. You take out your sidearm in a panic, but as you look back up at the alien figure, you notice that they too enter a defensive stance - but not towards you. A large maw bursts open in the sand to your left, and out of it comes a massive creature hundreds of times your size, covered in spikes and scales. You barely have time to react as it plummets onto the sand to your right, but you get a glimpse of the alien creature riding the beast as they impale it with their weapon.|56|0
units.english: Suddenly, the ground starts to vibrate intensely. You take out your sidearm in a panic, but as you look back up at the alien figure, you notice that they too enter a defensive stance - but not towards you. A large maw bursts open in the sand to your left, and out of it comes a massive creature hundreds of times your size, covered in spikes and scales. You barely have time to react as it plummets onto the sand to your right, but you get a glimpse of the alien creature riding the beast as they impale it with their weapon.
units.italian: Improvvisamente il terreno comincia a vibrare con intensità. In preda al panico estrai l'arma da fianco, ma quando rialzi lo sguardo verso la figura aliena noti che anche lei ha preso una posizione difensiva. Non verso di te. Alla tua sinistra si apre una grande fauce nella sabbia, e ne esce una creatura enorme, centinaia di volte più grande di te, coperta di spuntoni e squame. Hai appena il tempo di reagire: piomba sulla sabbia alla tua destra, ma fai in tempo a intravedere la creatura aliena che cavalca la bestia e la trafigge con la sua arma.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	(Leave the planet immediately.)|58|0
units.english: (Leave the planet immediately.)
units.italian: (Lascia il pianeta immediatamente.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	(Distance myself from the site but continue to watch.)|60|0
units.english: (Distance myself from the site but continue to watch.)
units.italian: (Allontanati dal sito ma continua a guardare.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	(Try to help the alien defeat the beast.)|62|0
units.english: (Try to help the alien defeat the beast.)
units.italian: (Prova ad aiutare l'alieno a sconfiggere la bestia.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	You aim your sidearm at the beast, preparing to fire. Instead of digging back under the surface, the beast continues to thrash about where it is while the alien batters it down with their spear weapon. Making sure you don't accidentally hit them, you hold your breath and wait until the right moment comes, aiming for the creature's head. The flailing creature begins to get closer, and your pulse begins to race. A gust of sand blasts directly towards you, and once it clears you fire your weapon. A shot flies directly into the face of the beast.|64|0
units.english: You aim your sidearm at the beast, preparing to fire. Instead of digging back under the surface, the beast continues to thrash about where it is while the alien batters it down with their spear weapon. Making sure you don't accidentally hit them, you hold your breath and wait until the right moment comes, aiming for the creature's head. The flailing creature begins to get closer, and your pulse begins to race. A gust of sand blasts directly towards you, and once it clears you fire your weapon. A shot flies directly into the face of the beast.
units.italian: Punti l'arma da fianco verso la bestia, pronto a sparare. Invece di rituffarsi sotto la superficie, la bestia continua a dibattersi dov'è mentre l'alieno la colpisce con l'arma a lancia. Per non rischiare di colpirlo, trattieni il respiro e aspetti il momento giusto, mirando alla testa della creatura. La creatura che si dimena comincia ad avvicinarsi e il tuo polso accelera. Una raffica di sabbia ti investe in pieno, e appena si dirada spari. Un colpo vola dritto in faccia alla bestia.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	Much to your dismay, the shot almost immediately ricochets off of it. You watch as the massive monster tumbles over you, just barely leaping into the air above. The monster plunges into the earth behind you, and you fall to your back with the wind knocked out of you. You raise your sidearm once more. The creature explodes out of the ground with its gaping mouth pointed upward to the sky. With shaking hands, you take aim once again and pull the trigger.|65|0
units.english: Much to your dismay, the shot almost immediately ricochets off of it. You watch as the massive monster tumbles over you, just barely leaping into the air above. The monster plunges into the earth behind you, and you fall to your back with the wind knocked out of you. You raise your sidearm once more. The creature explodes out of the ground with its gaping mouth pointed upward to the sky. With shaking hands, you take aim once again and pull the trigger.
units.italian: Con tuo sgomento, il colpo rimbalza quasi subito. Guardi il mostro enorme rotolarti addosso e lo schivi appena saltando in aria. Il mostro piomba nel terreno dietro di te, e tu cadi sulla schiena con il fiato mozzato. Alzi di nuovo l'arma. La creatura esplode dal suolo con la bocca spalancata rivolta al cielo. Con le mani che tremano prendi di nuovo la mira e premi il grilletto.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	A loud, cannon-like bang follows, but it most certainly did not come from your weapon. The beast before you falls downward in a cloud of black smoke, blasting sand and rubble everywhere with a thud. Once you come to your senses, you see the alien marching out of the creature's mouth.|66|0
units.english: A loud, cannon-like bang follows, but it most certainly did not come from your weapon. The beast before you falls downward in a cloud of black smoke, blasting sand and rubble everywhere with a thud. Once you come to your senses, you see the alien marching out of the creature's mouth.
units.italian: Segue un boato forte, come di cannone, ma di certo non viene dalla tua arma. La bestia davanti a te crolla in una nuvola di fumo nero, spargendo sabbia e detriti ovunque con un tonfo. Quando ti riprendi, vedi l'alieno che esce dalla bocca della creatura.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	(Approach the alien.)|68|0
units.english: (Approach the alien.)
units.italian: (Avvicinati all'alieno.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	(Get up and run to my ship.)|69|0
units.english: (Get up and run to my ship.)
units.italian: (Alzati e corri alla mia nave.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	Before you can collect yourself, you realize the alien is now much closer to you. Within a matter of moments, the alien stands before you, giving you a much better look at them. They are much taller than you, extremely bulky, and slightly hunched over. Heavy-looking metal surrounds their body, and in any exposed areas are rough-looking patches of skin and hair. Thick facial hair covers their face, and above their human-like eyes are a pair of horns curved inward towards you.|70|0
units.english: Before you can collect yourself, you realize the alien is now much closer to you. Within a matter of moments, the alien stands before you, giving you a much better look at them. They are much taller than you, extremely bulky, and slightly hunched over. Heavy-looking metal surrounds their body, and in any exposed areas are rough-looking patches of skin and hair. Thick facial hair covers their face, and above their human-like eyes are a pair of horns curved inward towards you.
units.italian: Prima che tu riesca a raccimolare le idee, ti accorgi che l'alieno è molto più vicino. Nel giro di un attimo ti sta davanti, e lo vedi molto meglio. È molto più alto di te, estremamente massiccio e leggermente incurvato. Un metallo pesante gli copre il corpo, e nelle zone scoperte si vedono chiazze di pelle e pelo ruvidi. Una folta barba gli copre il viso e sopra i suoi occhi, simili a quelli umani, ha un paio di corna curve verso l'interno, verso di te.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	Awkward silence ensues, and the alien looks you up and down in an unenthused way. They emit a very deep grumble, and with a loud snort, reach into a crevice in their armor to grab something. Pulling out what looks to be some sort of star map, they point to a location on it, gesture to themselves, then lower the device slowly to you. It seems they want to be taken to one of their species' planets.|71|0
units.english: Awkward silence ensues, and the alien looks you up and down in an unenthused way. They emit a very deep grumble, and with a loud snort, reach into a crevice in their armor to grab something. Pulling out what looks to be some sort of star map, they point to a location on it, gesture to themselves, then lower the device slowly to you. It seems they want to be taken to one of their species' planets.
units.italian: Segue un silenzio imbarazzante, e l'alieno ti squadra dalla testa ai piedi con aria poco entusiasta. Emette un brontolio molto profondo e con uno sbuffo rumoroso infila la mano in una fessura dell'armatura per prendere qualcosa. Estrae quella che sembra una sorta di carta stellare, indica un punto sulla mappa, fa un gesto verso di sé e poi abbassa lentamente il dispositivo verso di te. Sembra che voglia essere portato su uno dei pianeti della sua specie.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	(Accept their request.)|73|0
units.english: (Accept their request.)
units.italian: (Accetta la loro richiesta.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	(Ask about their request.)|74|0
units.english: (Ask about their request.)
units.italian: (Chiedi informazioni sulla loro richiesta.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	(Reject their request.)|76|0
units.english: (Reject their request.)
units.italian: (Rifiuta la loro richiesta.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	You hesitantly take the device and turn to make your way to your ship. Before leaving, you take one last glimpse of the enormous creature in the background. Its head appears dragon-like, though with numerous eyes and a mane of spikes. A few small appendages sprout from its neck, giving it a scaly, salamander-like appearance. The various signatures on your radar earlier must have been others of their kind. The alien glares at you, then at the creature, before turning back to you once more to continue towards your ship.|78|0
units.english: You hesitantly take the device and turn to make your way to your ship. Before leaving, you take one last glimpse of the enormous creature in the background. Its head appears dragon-like, though with numerous eyes and a mane of spikes. A few small appendages sprout from its neck, giving it a scaly, salamander-like appearance. The various signatures on your radar earlier must have been others of their kind. The alien glares at you, then at the creature, before turning back to you once more to continue towards your ship.
units.italian: Prendi il dispositivo con esitazione e ti volti per andare verso la nave. Prima di partire dai un'ultima occhiata all'enorme creatura sullo sfondo. La testa sembra quella di un drago, ma con numerosi occhi e una criniera di spuntoni. Dal collo le spuntano alcuni piccoli appendici, che le danno un aspetto squamoso, da salamandra. I vari segnali che il radar aveva rilevato prima dovevano essere altri della sua specie. L'alieno fissa te, poi la creatura, poi di nuovo te, e riprende a camminare verso la nave.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	You try to ask the alien about the trip, but they simply give you a blank stare for a few seconds before shoving the star map into your chest, letting go of it. You reactively catch it, almost falling over yourself, and then take one last glance at the enormous creature in the background. Its head is very reptilian, close to dragon-like, with numerous eyes and a mane of spikes. A few small appendages are on either end of it, almost like a scaly salamander. Turning around, you see that the alien is already far ahead of you, and you rush after so they aren't first to your ship.|81|0
units.english: You try to ask the alien about the trip, but they simply give you a blank stare for a few seconds before shoving the star map into your chest, letting go of it. You reactively catch it, almost falling over yourself, and then take one last glance at the enormous creature in the background. Its head is very reptilian, close to dragon-like, with numerous eyes and a mane of spikes. A few small appendages are on either end of it, almost like a scaly salamander. Turning around, you see that the alien is already far ahead of you, and you rush after so they aren't first to your ship.
units.italian: Provi a chiedere all'alieno del viaggio, ma lui ti fissa nel vuoto per qualche secondo e poi ti caccia la carta stellare sul petto, lasciandola andare. La afferri d'istinto, quasi cadendo, e poi dai un'ultima occhiata all'enorme creatura sullo sfondo. La testa è molto rettiliana, quasi draconiana, con numerosi occhi e una criniera di spuntoni. Alle due estremità ha piccoli appendici, quasi da salamandra squamosa. Ti volti e vedi che l'alieno è già molto avanti: gli corri dietro per non farlo arrivare primo alla nave.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	You shake your head and decline the request of the alien after having dealt with everything that's happened. Turning back towards your ship to leave, you suddenly find yourself face-first in the ground, coughing up sand and dust, and hear the device hit the ground beside you. In frustration, you quickly get up and look for the alien, who is already marching towards your ship in the distance. Perhaps it wasn't the best idea to decline the request and turn your back on a being several times larger than you, who just took down a beast hundreds of times the size of them. You turn to look at the huge creature one last time. Its head is very reptilian, close to dragon-like, with numerous eyes and a mane of spikes. Definitely something more dangerous than you could ever be on foot.|84|0
units.english: You shake your head and decline the request of the alien after having dealt with everything that's happened. Turning back towards your ship to leave, you suddenly find yourself face-first in the ground, coughing up sand and dust, and hear the device hit the ground beside you. In frustration, you quickly get up and look for the alien, who is already marching towards your ship in the distance. Perhaps it wasn't the best idea to decline the request and turn your back on a being several times larger than you, who just took down a beast hundreds of times the size of them. You turn to look at the huge creature one last time. Its head is very reptilian, close to dragon-like, with numerous eyes and a mane of spikes. Definitely something more dangerous than you could ever be on foot.
units.italian: Scuoti la testa e, dopo tutto quello che è successo, rifiuti la richiesta dell'alieno. Ti volti verso la nave per andartene e ti ritrovi all'improvviso con la faccia a terra, a sputare sabbia e polvere, e senti il dispositivo cadere accanto a te. Con stizza ti rialzi in fretta e cerchi l'alieno, che è già lontano e marcia verso la tua nave. Forse non è stata una grande idea rifiutare la richiesta e voltare le spalle a un essere diverse volte più grande di te, che ha appena abbattuto una bestia centinaia di volte più grande di lui. Ti volti a guardare l'enorme creatura un'ultima volta. La testa è molto rettiliana, quasi draconiana, con numerosi occhi e una criniera di spuntoni. Decisamente qualcosa di più pericoloso di quanto potrai mai essere a piedi.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	Cautiously retreating towards your ship, you keep your eyes and ears peeled for the creature, wondering if and where it might appear again. As if to answer your inquiry, the ground begins to rumble, and off to your left, sand and rubble erupt into the air as the beast twists and turns across the surface. Following a loud bellow, the creature screeches in short bursts, almost like chirps, except much deeper than that of a bird. As some of the dust clears, you see the alien figure breathing intensely as they continue to battle the beast.|88|0
units.english: Cautiously retreating towards your ship, you keep your eyes and ears peeled for the creature, wondering if and where it might appear again. As if to answer your inquiry, the ground begins to rumble, and off to your left, sand and rubble erupt into the air as the beast twists and turns across the surface. Following a loud bellow, the creature screeches in short bursts, almost like chirps, except much deeper than that of a bird. As some of the dust clears, you see the alien figure breathing intensely as they continue to battle the beast.
units.italian: Ti ritiri con cautela verso la nave, con occhi e orecchie bene aperti sulla creatura, chiedendoti se e dove ricomparirà. Come per rispondere alla tua domanda, il terreno comincia a tremare e alla tua sinistra sabbia e detriti schizzano in aria mentre la bestia si torce e si dimena sulla superficie. Dopo un ruggito profondo, la creatura stridisce a scatti brevi, quasi dei cinguettii, ma molto più gravi di quelli di un uccello. Mentre parte della polvere si dirada, vedi la figura aliena che respira affannosamente mentre continua a combattere la bestia.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	(Help the alien.)|90|0
units.english: (Help the alien.)
units.italian: (Aiuta l'alieno.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	(Leave.)|92|0
units.english: (Leave.)
units.italian: (Vattene.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	With the situation beginning to spin out of your control, you quickly turn around and make for your ship, taking off as soon as you can. You wonder what will become of the alien figure as while they are most certainly a member of the species inhabiting the nearby systems, it doesn't seem like any help will be sent for them anytime soon.|95|0
units.english: With the situation beginning to spin out of your control, you quickly turn around and make for your ship, taking off as soon as you can. You wonder what will become of the alien figure as while they are most certainly a member of the species inhabiting the nearby systems, it doesn't seem like any help will be sent for them anytime soon.
units.italian: Con la situazione che comincia a sfuggirti di mano, ti volti in fretta e corri alla nave, decollando appena possibile. Ti chiedi che ne sarà della figura aliena: è senz'altro un membro della specie che abita i sistemi vicini, ma non sembra che gli arriveranno aiuti a breve.

As you continue your flight, another sudden dust cloud appears several minutes later, but still nothing on the radar. You decide to keep your ship a few thousand meters above the surface and take the time to carefully look around, but there still doesn't seem to be anything of note besides the cracked rock formations and valleys of sand.|99|0
units.english: As you descend towards the surface of this seemingly uninhabited world, you activate your ship's radar system to scan the surface for anything of interest. While waiting for something to appear, you look up and catch a glimpse of a cloud of dust bursting from the ground far off to your right. Peering back down to your radar, you check the surface scans of that direction, but nothing appears. As you continue your flight, another sudden dust cloud appears several minutes later, but still nothing on the radar. You decide to keep your ship a few thousand meters above the surface and take the time to carefully look around, but there still doesn't seem to be anything of note besides the cracked rock formations and valleys of sand.
units.italian: Mentre scendi verso la superficie di questo mondo apparentemente disabitato, attivi il radar della nave per scansionare il terreno in cerca di qualcosa di interessante. Mentre aspetti che compaia qualcosa, alzi lo sguardo e intravedi una nuvola di polvere che esplode dal suolo lontano alla tua destra. Torni a guardare il radar e controlli le scansioni di quella direzione, ma non appare nulla. Mentre continui il volo, qualche minuto dopo compare un'altra nuvola di polvere, ma sul radar ancora niente. Decidi di tenere la nave qualche migliaio di metri sopra la superficie e di prenderti il tempo di guardarti bene intorno, ma oltre alle formazioni rocciose crepate e alle valli di sabbia non sembra esserci niente degno di nota.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	Suddenly, your radar systems pick up a larger signal on the horizon, and you see a bulky, rock-like structure. Once you get close enough, you recognize it as one of the Gegno's warships, although it is half sunken into the sand.|100|0
units.english: Suddenly, your radar systems pick up a larger signal on the horizon, and you see a bulky, rock-like structure. Once you get close enough, you recognize it as one of the Gegno's warships, although it is half sunken into the sand.
units.italian: Improvvisamente il radar rileva un segnale più grande all'orizzonte, e vedi una struttura massiccia, simile a una roccia. Quando ti avvicini abbastanza, riconosci una delle navi da guerra dei Gegno, anche se è per metà sprofondata nella sabbia.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	(Investigate the Gegno ship.)|102|0
units.english: (Investigate the Gegno ship.)
units.italian: (Indaga sulla nave dei Gegno.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	(Resume my search of the surface.)|104|0
units.english: (Resume my search of the surface.)
units.italian: (Riprendi la ricerca sulla superficie.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	You carefully land your ship nearby. Most of the faint radar signatures from earlier have disappeared out of range. Exiting your ship in an environment suit and your sidearm on hand, you walk towards the Gegno ship.|107|0
units.english: You carefully land your ship nearby. Most of the faint radar signatures from earlier have disappeared out of range. Exiting your ship in an environment suit and your sidearm on hand, you walk towards the Gegno ship.
units.italian: Atterri con cautela nelle vicinanze. La maggior parte dei deboli segnali radar di prima è scomparsa fuori portata. Scendi dalla nave in tuta ambientale con l'arma da fianco pronta e ti avvicini alla nave dei Gegno.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	The ship appears a bit larger than you thought - around the size of a Firebird. The dark-brown hull appears to be made from an unknown material, and has several metallic-looking parts both hatched in crevices and protruding outward, indicative of the Gegno Vi's brutish aesthetics. Oddly enough, the warship seems perfectly intact, but the way it is angled into the sand suggests that the ship has been here for some time. There doesn't seem to be any activity around it, and you aren't picking up any nearby signs of life. You decide to head back to your ship and take another look around the area.|108|0
units.english: The ship appears a bit larger than you thought - around the size of a Firebird. The dark-brown hull appears to be made from an unknown material, and has several metallic-looking parts both hatched in crevices and protruding outward, indicative of the Gegno Vi's brutish aesthetics. Oddly enough, the warship seems perfectly intact, but the way it is angled into the sand suggests that the ship has been here for some time. There doesn't seem to be any activity around it, and you aren't picking up any nearby signs of life. You decide to head back to your ship and take another look around the area.
units.italian: La nave sembra un po' più grande di quanto pensassi, all'incirca delle dimensioni di un Firebird. Lo scafo bruno scuro sembra fatto di un materiale sconosciuto e presenta diverse parti dall'aspetto metallico, incassate nelle fessure e sporgenti verso l'esterno, segno dell'estetica brutale dei Gegno Vi. Stranamente la nave da guerra pare perfettamente intatta, ma il modo in cui è inclinata nella sabbia lascia pensare che sia lì da tempo. Intorno non sembra esserci attività e non rilevi segni di vita nelle vicinanze. Decidi di tornare alla nave e dare un'altra occhiata alla zona.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	As you fly onward, an erratic signature appears on the edge of your radar. A large arch-like structure becomes visible in the distance, but disappears shortly after. You set your ship down close where it originated from and exit to investigate, donning your environment suit with your sidearm at hand.|110|0
units.english: As you fly onward, an erratic signature appears on the edge of your radar. A large arch-like structure becomes visible in the distance, but disappears shortly after. You set your ship down close where it originated from and exit to investigate, donning your environment suit with your sidearm at hand.
units.italian: Mentre voli, un segnale irregolare compare al margine del radar. In lontananza si intravede una grande struttura ad arco, che poco dopo scompare. Posi la nave vicino al punto di origine e scendi a indagare, indossando la tuta ambientale con l'arma da fianco a portata di mano.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	Much to your surprise, there is a large humanoid figure standing in front of you. It looks nothing like the Gegno you've seen on the nearby Quarg ringworld; it is large, bulky, and clad in metallic armor. In one of its hands is a spear-like weapon; you guess that they are a Gegno Vi based on their appearance. The Vi moves around attentively, focused on its surroundings, but appears to take no interest in your presence.|111|0
units.english: Much to your surprise, there is a large humanoid figure standing in front of you. It looks nothing like the Gegno you've seen on the nearby Quarg ringworld; it is large, bulky, and clad in metallic armor. In one of its hands is a spear-like weapon; you guess that they are a Gegno Vi based on their appearance. The Vi moves around attentively, focused on its surroundings, but appears to take no interest in your presence.
units.italian: Con tua grande sorpresa, davanti a te c'è una grande figura umanoide. Non somiglia per niente ai Gegno che hai visto sul mondo ad anello dei Quarg: è grande, massiccia e rivestita di armatura metallica. In una mano tiene un'arma a forma di lancia; dall'aspetto diresti che è un Gegno Vi. Il Vi si muove con attenzione, concentrato su ciò che lo circonda, ma non sembra interessato alla tua presenza.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	(Approach the Vi warrior.)|113|0
units.english: (Approach the Vi warrior.)
units.italian: (Avvicinati al guerriero Vi.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	(Turn back to my ship.)|114|0
units.english: (Turn back to my ship.)
units.italian: (Torna alla mia nave.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	Suddenly, the ground starts to vibrate intensely. You take out your sidearm in a panic, but as you look back up at the Vi, you notice that they too enter a defensive stance - but not towards you. A large maw bursts open in the sand to your left, and out of it comes a massive creature hundreds of times the size of you, covered in spikes and scales. You barely have time to react as it plummets onto the sand to your right, but you get a glimpse of the Vi riding the beast as they impale it with their weapon.|115|0
units.english: Suddenly, the ground starts to vibrate intensely. You take out your sidearm in a panic, but as you look back up at the Vi, you notice that they too enter a defensive stance - but not towards you. A large maw bursts open in the sand to your left, and out of it comes a massive creature hundreds of times the size of you, covered in spikes and scales. You barely have time to react as it plummets onto the sand to your right, but you get a glimpse of the Vi riding the beast as they impale it with their weapon.
units.italian: Improvvisamente il terreno comincia a vibrare con intensità. In preda al panico estrai l'arma da fianco, ma quando rialzi lo sguardo verso il Vi noti che anche lui ha preso una posizione difensiva. Non verso di te. Alla tua sinistra si apre una grande fauce nella sabbia, e ne esce una creatura enorme, centinaia di volte più grande di te, coperta di spuntoni e squame. Hai appena il tempo di reagire: piomba sulla sabbia alla tua destra, ma fai in tempo a intravedere il Vi che cavalca la bestia e la trafigge con la sua arma.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	(Observe the situation from a distance.)|117|0
units.english: (Observe the situation from a distance.)
units.italian: (Osserva la situazione a distanza.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	(Assist the Vi in defeating the beast.)|119|0
units.english: (Assist the Vi in defeating the beast.)
units.italian: (Aiuta il Vi a sconfiggere la bestia.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	You bring your sidearm up to a firing position and wait for the beast. Once again, it jumps out of the sand in an incredible display, but instead of digging back under the surface, the beast continues to thrash about where it is while the Vi batters it down with their spear weapon. Making sure you don't accidentally hit them, you hold your breath and wait until the right moment comes, aiming for the creature's head. The flailing creature begins to get closer, and your pulse begins to race. A gust of sand blasts directly towards you, and once it clears you fire your weapon. A shot flies directly into the face of the beast.|121|0
units.english: You bring your sidearm up to a firing position and wait for the beast. Once again, it jumps out of the sand in an incredible display, but instead of digging back under the surface, the beast continues to thrash about where it is while the Vi batters it down with their spear weapon. Making sure you don't accidentally hit them, you hold your breath and wait until the right moment comes, aiming for the creature's head. The flailing creature begins to get closer, and your pulse begins to race. A gust of sand blasts directly towards you, and once it clears you fire your weapon. A shot flies directly into the face of the beast.
units.italian: Porti l'arma da fianco in posizione di tiro e aspetti la bestia. Ancora una volta salta fuori dalla sabbia con uno spettacolo incredibile, ma invece di rituffarsi sotto la superficie continua a dibattersi dov'è mentre il Vi la colpisce con l'arma a lancia. Per non rischiare di colpirlo, trattieni il respiro e aspetti il momento giusto, mirando alla testa della creatura. La creatura che si dimena comincia ad avvicinarsi e il tuo polso accelera. Una raffica di sabbia ti investe in pieno, e appena si dirada spari. Un colpo vola dritto in faccia alla bestia.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	Much to your dismay, the shot almost immediately ricochets off of it. You watch as the massive monster tumbles over you, just barely leaping into the air above. The monster plunges into the earth behind you, and you fall to your back with the wind knocked out of you. You raise your sidearm once more. The creature explodes out of the ground with its gaping mouth pointed upward to the sky. With shaking hands, you take aim once again and pull the trigger.|122|0
units.english: Much to your dismay, the shot almost immediately ricochets off of it. You watch as the massive monster tumbles over you, just barely leaping into the air above. The monster plunges into the earth behind you, and you fall to your back with the wind knocked out of you. You raise your sidearm once more. The creature explodes out of the ground with its gaping mouth pointed upward to the sky. With shaking hands, you take aim once again and pull the trigger.
units.italian: Con tuo sgomento, il colpo rimbalza quasi subito. Guardi il mostro enorme rotolarti addosso e lo schivi appena saltando in aria. Il mostro piomba nel terreno dietro di te, e tu cadi sulla schiena con il fiato mozzato. Alzi di nuovo l'arma. La creatura esplode dal suolo con la bocca spalancata rivolta al cielo. Con le mani che tremano prendi di nuovo la mira e premi il grilletto.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	A loud, cannon-like bang follows, but it most certainly did not come from your weapon. The beast before you falls downward in a cloud of black smoke, blasting sand and rubble everywhere with a thud. Once you come to your senses, you see the Vi marching out of the creature's mouth.|123|0
units.english: A loud, cannon-like bang follows, but it most certainly did not come from your weapon. The beast before you falls downward in a cloud of black smoke, blasting sand and rubble everywhere with a thud. Once you come to your senses, you see the Vi marching out of the creature's mouth.
units.italian: Segue un boato forte, come di cannone, ma di certo non viene dalla tua arma. La bestia davanti a te crolla in una nuvola di fumo nero, spargendo sabbia e detriti ovunque con un tonfo. Quando ti riprendi, vedi il Vi che esce dalla bocca della creatura.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	(Approach the Vi.)|125|0
units.english: (Approach the Vi.)
units.italian: (Avvicinati al Vi.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	(Get up and run to my ship.)|126|0
units.english: (Get up and run to my ship.)
units.italian: (Alzati e corri alla mia nave.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	Before you can collect yourself, you realize the Vi warrior is now much closer to you. Within a matter of moments, the alien stands before you, giving you a much better look at them. They are much taller than both you and the other Gegno you've seen, extremely bulky, and slightly hunched over. Heavy-looking metal surrounds their body, and in any exposed areas are rough-looking patches of skin and hair. Thick facial hair covers their face, and above their human-like eyes are a pair of horns curved inward towards you.|127|0
units.english: Before you can collect yourself, you realize the Vi warrior is now much closer to you. Within a matter of moments, the alien stands before you, giving you a much better look at them. They are much taller than both you and the other Gegno you've seen, extremely bulky, and slightly hunched over. Heavy-looking metal surrounds their body, and in any exposed areas are rough-looking patches of skin and hair. Thick facial hair covers their face, and above their human-like eyes are a pair of horns curved inward towards you.
units.italian: Prima che tu riesca a raccimolare le idee, ti accorgi che il guerriero Vi è molto più vicino. Nel giro di un attimo l'alieno ti sta davanti e lo vedi molto meglio. È molto più alto di te e degli altri Gegno che hai visto, estremamente massiccio e leggermente incurvato. Un metallo pesante gli copre il corpo, e nelle zone scoperte si vedono chiazze di pelle e pelo ruvidi. Una folta barba gli copre il viso e sopra i suoi occhi, simili a quelli umani, ha un paio di corna curve verso l'interno, verso di te.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	While the Gegno are known to dislike outsiders, this particular Gegno seems to at the very least acknowledge you. After a period of awkward and what seems to be judgmental silence, the Vi looks you up and down in an unenthused manner. They emit a very deep grumble, and with a loud snort, reach into a crevice in their armor to grab something. Pulling out what looks to be some sort of star map, they point to a location on it, gesture to themselves, then lower the device slowly to you. It seems they want to be taken to one of the Gegno's planets.|128|0
units.english: While the Gegno are known to dislike outsiders, this particular Gegno seems to at the very least acknowledge you. After a period of awkward and what seems to be judgmental silence, the Vi looks you up and down in an unenthused manner. They emit a very deep grumble, and with a loud snort, reach into a crevice in their armor to grab something. Pulling out what looks to be some sort of star map, they point to a location on it, gesture to themselves, then lower the device slowly to you. It seems they want to be taken to one of the Gegno's planets.
units.italian: Per quanto i Gegno siano noti per non amare gli estranei, questo in particolare sembra almeno riconoscere la tua presenza. Dopo un silenzio imbarazzante e, a quanto pare, giudicante, il Vi ti squadra dalla testa ai piedi con aria poco entusiasta. Emette un brontolio molto profondo e con uno sbuffo rumoroso infila la mano in una fessura dell'armatura per prendere qualcosa. Estrae quella che sembra una sorta di carta stellare, indica un punto sulla mappa, fa un gesto verso di sé e poi abbassa lentamente il dispositivo verso di te. Sembra che voglia essere portato su uno dei pianeti dei Gegno.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	(Accept their request.)|130|0
units.english: (Accept their request.)
units.italian: (Accetta la loro richiesta.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	(Ask about their request.)|131|0
units.english: (Ask about their request.)
units.italian: (Chiedi informazioni sulla loro richiesta.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	(Reject their request.)|133|0
units.english: (Reject their request.)
units.italian: (Rifiuta la loro richiesta.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	You hesitantly take the device and turn to make your way to your ship. Before leaving, you take one last glimpse of the enormous creature in the background. Its head appears dragon-like, though with numerous eyes and a mane of spikes. A few small appendages sprout from its neck, giving it a scaly, salamander-like appearance. The various signatures on your radar earlier must have been others of their kind. The Vi warrior glares at you, then at the creature, before turning back to you once more to continue towards your ship.|135|0
units.english: You hesitantly take the device and turn to make your way to your ship. Before leaving, you take one last glimpse of the enormous creature in the background. Its head appears dragon-like, though with numerous eyes and a mane of spikes. A few small appendages sprout from its neck, giving it a scaly, salamander-like appearance. The various signatures on your radar earlier must have been others of their kind. The Vi warrior glares at you, then at the creature, before turning back to you once more to continue towards your ship.
units.italian: Prendi il dispositivo con esitazione e ti volti per andare verso la nave. Prima di partire dai un'ultima occhiata all'enorme creatura sullo sfondo. La testa sembra quella di un drago, ma con numerosi occhi e una criniera di spuntoni. Dal collo le spuntano alcuni piccoli appendici, che le danno un aspetto squamoso, da salamandra. I vari segnali che il radar aveva rilevato prima dovevano essere altri della sua specie. Il guerriero Vi fissa te, poi la creatura, poi di nuovo te, e riprende a camminare verso la nave.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	You try to ask the Gegno about the trip, but they simply give you a blank stare for a few seconds before shoving the star map into your chest, letting go of it. You reactively catch it, almost falling over yourself, and then take one last glance at the enormous creature in the background. Its head is very reptilian, close to dragon-like, with numerous eyes and a mane of spikes. A few small appendages are on either end of it, almost like a scaly salamander. Turning around, you see that the Gegno is already far ahead of you, and you rush after so they aren't first to your ship.|138|0
units.english: You try to ask the Gegno about the trip, but they simply give you a blank stare for a few seconds before shoving the star map into your chest, letting go of it. You reactively catch it, almost falling over yourself, and then take one last glance at the enormous creature in the background. Its head is very reptilian, close to dragon-like, with numerous eyes and a mane of spikes. A few small appendages are on either end of it, almost like a scaly salamander. Turning around, you see that the Gegno is already far ahead of you, and you rush after so they aren't first to your ship.
units.italian: Provi a chiedere al Gegno del viaggio, ma lui ti fissa nel vuoto per qualche secondo e poi ti caccia la carta stellare sul petto, lasciandola andare. La afferri d'istinto, quasi cadendo, e poi dai un'ultima occhiata all'enorme creatura sullo sfondo. La testa è molto rettiliana, quasi draconiana, con numerosi occhi e una criniera di spuntoni. Alle due estremità ha piccoli appendici, quasi da salamandra squamosa. Ti volti e vedi che il Gegno è già molto avanti: gli corri dietro per non farlo arrivare primo alla nave.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	You shake your head and decline the request of the Gegno after having dealt with everything that's happened. Turning back towards your ship to leave, you suddenly find yourself face-first in the ground, coughing up sand and dust, and hear the device hit the ground beside you. In frustration, you quickly get up and look for the Gegno, who is already marching towards your ship in the distance. Perhaps it wasn't the best idea to decline the request and turn your back on a being several times larger than you who just took down a beast hundreds of times the size of them. You turn to look at the huge creature one last time. Its head is very reptilian, close to dragon-like, with numerous eyes and a mane of spikes. Definitely something more dangerous than you could ever be on foot.|141|0
units.english: You shake your head and decline the request of the Gegno after having dealt with everything that's happened. Turning back towards your ship to leave, you suddenly find yourself face-first in the ground, coughing up sand and dust, and hear the device hit the ground beside you. In frustration, you quickly get up and look for the Gegno, who is already marching towards your ship in the distance. Perhaps it wasn't the best idea to decline the request and turn your back on a being several times larger than you who just took down a beast hundreds of times the size of them. You turn to look at the huge creature one last time. Its head is very reptilian, close to dragon-like, with numerous eyes and a mane of spikes. Definitely something more dangerous than you could ever be on foot.
units.italian: Scuoti la testa e, dopo tutto quello che è successo, rifiuti la richiesta del Gegno. Ti volti verso la nave per andartene e ti ritrovi all'improvviso con la faccia a terra, a sputare sabbia e polvere, e senti il dispositivo cadere accanto a te. Con stizza ti rialzi in fretta e cerchi il Gegno, che è già lontano e marcia verso la tua nave. Forse non è stata una grande idea rifiutare la richiesta e voltare le spalle a un essere diverse volte più grande di te, che ha appena abbattuto una bestia centinaia di volte più grande di lui. Ti volti a guardare l'enorme creatura un'ultima volta. La testa è molto rettiliana, quasi draconiana, con numerosi occhi e una criniera di spuntoni. Decisamente qualcosa di più pericoloso di quanto potrai mai essere a piedi.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	Cautiously retreating to a safer distance, you keep your eyes and ears peeled for the creature, wondering if and where it might appear again. As if to answer your inquiry, the ground begins to rumble, and off to your left, sand and rubble erupt into the air as the beast twists and turns across the surface. Following a loud bellow, the creature screeches in short bursts, almost like chirps, except much deeper than that of a bird. As some of the dust clears, you see the Vi breathing intensely as they continue to battle the beast.|145|0
units.english: Cautiously retreating to a safer distance, you keep your eyes and ears peeled for the creature, wondering if and where it might appear again. As if to answer your inquiry, the ground begins to rumble, and off to your left, sand and rubble erupt into the air as the beast twists and turns across the surface. Following a loud bellow, the creature screeches in short bursts, almost like chirps, except much deeper than that of a bird. As some of the dust clears, you see the Vi breathing intensely as they continue to battle the beast.
units.italian: Ti ritiri con cautela a una distanza più sicura, con occhi e orecchie bene aperti sulla creatura, chiedendoti se e dove ricomparirà. Come per rispondere alla tua domanda, il terreno comincia a tremare e alla tua sinistra sabbia e detriti schizzano in aria mentre la bestia si torce e si dimena sulla superficie. Dopo un ruggito profondo, la creatura stridisce a scatti brevi, quasi dei cinguettii, ma molto più gravi di quelli di un uccello. Mentre parte della polvere si dirada, vedi il Vi che respira affannosamente mentre continua a combattere la bestia.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	(Assist the Vi.)|147|0
units.english: (Assist the Vi.)
units.italian: (Aiuta il Vi.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|label|150|0
units.english: return encounter
units.italian: return encounter

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|You find yourself approaching this desert world once again, wondering what happened to the alien figure you previously encountered. Knowing the world is home to a dangerous indigenous species, you are hesitant on landing, making sure to stay clear of any signs of creatures like the one from before.|151|0
units.english: You find yourself approaching this desert world once again, wondering what happened to the alien figure you previously encountered. Knowing the world is home to a dangerous indigenous species, you are hesitant on landing, making sure to stay clear of any signs of creatures like the one from before.
units.italian: Ti ritrovi ad avvicinarti di nuovo a questo mondo desertico, chiedendoti che ne sia stato della figura aliena incontrata prima. Sapendo che il mondo ospita una specie indigena pericolosa, esiti ad atterrare e ti assicuri di tenerti lontano da qualsiasi segno di creature come quella di prima.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	(Go search for the alien.)|153|0
units.english: (Go search for the alien.)
units.italian: (Vai a cercare l'alieno.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	(Carry on.)|155|0
units.english: (Carry on.)
units.italian: (Prosegui.)

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|label|158|0
units.english: search again
units.italian: search again

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	With the coordinates of the alien vessel still in the history of your ship's computer, you set off to find it again. On your flight there, your radar suddenly picks up another ship approaching, and you look up to see the same type of ship you saw before flying at a higher altitude over you in the opposite direction. It must be another pilot belonging to the alien species.|159|0
units.english: With the coordinates of the alien vessel still in the history of your ship's computer, you set off to find it again. On your flight there, your radar suddenly picks up another ship approaching, and you look up to see the same type of ship you saw before flying at a higher altitude over you in the opposite direction. It must be another pilot belonging to the alien species.
units.italian: Con le coordinate del vascello alieno ancora nella memoria del computer di bordo, ti metti di nuovo in cerca. Durante il volo il radar rileva all'improvviso un'altra nave in avvicinamento, e alzando lo sguardo vedi lo stesso tipo di nave di prima che ti passa sopra a quota più alta, in direzione opposta. Dev'essere un altro pilota della specie aliena.

units.italian: Pur sapendo che stai trasportando uno di loro, hai deciso consapevolmente di aprire il fuoco sulle navi <alien>, e il resto del viaggio verso questo mondo è stato estremamente imbarazzante. Invece di sistemarsi in una cuccetta, il passeggero <alien> è rimasto in piedi dietro di te nella cabina di pilotaggio per tutto il tempo. Ogni tanto ti voltavi a osservarne il comportamento e tentavi anche di comunicare, ma non guardava nemmeno nella tua direzione.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Gegno Vi|	Strangely, they didn't seem to be upset at all, at least in a way you could tell. Regardless, the tension became extremely uncomfortable, but now that you've landed your ship, perhaps you could address it.|180|0

units.italian: Stranamente non sembrava affatto arrabbiato, almeno non in modo riconoscibile. In ogni caso la tensione è diventata molto scomoda, ma ora che hai atterrato potresti affrontarla.

units.italian: Prima che tu possa voltarti a parlargli, senti una forza immensa attraversarti il torso e il corpo comincia lentamente a sollevarsi. Provi a parlare, ma non esce nulla; voltando la testa vedi che <alien> ti ha trapassato il petto con l'arma a lancia. Mentre la vista si offusca, l'ultima cosa che riesci a scorgere non è un'espressione d'odio, ma di delusione.

Occasionally, you made attempts to communicate with them again to break the pressure, but the most they would give you is a slight glance or low grunt.
units.italian: Il viaggio fin qui è stato pieno di tensione e tutto fuorché piacevole. Invece di sedersi normalmente, <alien> è rimasto in piedi dietro di te nella cabina di pilotaggio, a braccia conserte, per gran parte del tragitto, quasi fosse un macigno inamovibile. Ogni tanto hai tentato di nuovo di comunicare per allentare la pressione, ma il massimo che ottenevi era un'occhiata fugace o un grugnito.

units.id: mission:Visit Quarg in Gegno Space|	As you descend into the atmosphere, you watch as layers of dark smog quickly reveal massive cities glittered with various lights towering into the sky. The ships here are of different shades than the ones you previously saw, being more tan than dark brown, and are in a much larger quantity. The intensity of traffic, combined with the overwhelming mass of infrastructure, suggests that this is the homeworld of the <alien>. Before getting lost in the fantastical sight in front of you, the <alien> marches up next to you and raises one arm, gesturing to an enormous factory-like structure in the distance that stands out from other towers. You carefully guide your ship to the building and with the help of the <alien> find a suitable docking port to land on.|211|0

units.italian: Mentre scendi nell'atmosfera, vedi strati di smog scuro che svelano in fretta città enormi punteggiate di luci che si alzano verso il cielo. Le navi qui hanno tonalità diverse da quelle viste prima, più marrone chiaro che bruno scuro, e sono molto più numerose. L'intensità del traffico, insieme alla mole opprimente delle infrastrutture, suggerisce che questo è il mondo natale di <alien>. Prima che ti perda in quello spettacolo fantastico, <alien> ti si affianca e alza un braccio, indicando in lontananza un'enorme struttura simile a una fabbrica che spicca fra le altre torri. Guidi con cautela la nave verso l'edificio e, con l'aiuto di <alien>, trovi un portello di attracco adatto.

units.italian: Dopo l'atterraggio, diversi <aliens> simili a quello che ti sta accanto cominciano a mettersi in formazione verso la tua nave, tutti armati di vari tipi di armi simili a bastoni. Non mostrano però alcun segno di aggressività: restano semplicemente in posizione, in una dimostrazione coordinata di forza. L'<alien> accanto a te fa un gesto per avere il dispositivo a bussola che ti aveva dato prima.

Una volta riempito il serbatoio, l'<alien> che ti ha guidato fa un gesto verso il cielo. La tua visita al misterioso mondo natale degli <alien> dovrà essere abbreviata.
